name: Gnarrenburg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gnarrenburg (a red wall above a green leaf rosette on white).
history: Municipal flag of Gnarrenburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gnarrenburg arms — wall and leaf rosette
